purpose: Additive source/access/requirement/crosswalk data for direct-source IEEE review and SDOS runtime-governance intake. Crosswalks remain derivative and cannot assert source wording or Caelestis conformity.

sdos_controls.summary: Use versioned governance configuration to determine which modules and agent capabilities are active, enabling auditable and change-controlled activation without executable-code changes.
Assign the model capability tier for each dispatched task through the governance layer, prevent agent/model self-selection or override, and record the selection rationale.
Define a configuration-governed default-deny admission policy so agents cannot access governed operations unless admission criteria and scope conditions are satisfied.
Apply a common authoritative governance policy source and decision process across active modules to avoid inconsistent enforcement between modules.

Enforce governance constraints in a structural layer independent of model inference so model outputs cannot use an authorized pathway to override, bypass or modify the controls applied to their operations.
Classify each tool invocation by risk at the dispatch boundary before execution and use the current policy state to determine permit, conditional-permit or block disposition.
Assess task characteristics at dispatch and prevent tasks requiring higher analytical capability from being routed below the minimum capability tier identified for the task.
For policy-defined elevated-risk tasks, enforce a minimum model capability floor even when a lower tier would otherwise be permitted by complexity assessment.
Route governed outbound operations through a pre-execution policy enforcement point that permits, modifies or blocks the operation against current policy and records the decision.
Require each executing module to confirm a valid governance approval through a secondary module-level authorization check before carrying out the governed operation.

Use documented restrictive degradation rules when governance infrastructure is unavailable or indeterminate, and halt completely on governance-baseline integrity failure; block elevated-risk operations until governance is restored and verified.
Create a tamper-evident audit record for governed outbound execution, linking the permitting governance decision, initiating agent identity, time and protected policy-relevant operation metadata.
